baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ is answered by ٱرْجِعُوا۟ ... فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The petition treats light as a flame or good obtainable from another source; the reply blocks that transfer and reverses the seekers toward an independent search.

activation_trace.role: Light or good sought from another supplies the attempted derivative acquisition.
Illumination is first possessed by the addressed group and then named as the object of a separate search.
Return supplies the reversal that refuses immediate sharing.
Seeking makes acquisition an active task rather than passive proximity.

changed_reading.before: A group simply asks another group for illumination.
changed_reading.after: A late attempt to derive light from another source is refused and redirected into an impossible-seeming search of its own.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The المنافقون face a struck wall with a gate, an inward mercy, and an outward punishment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A people named by showing one entrance while hiding another encounter the same logic made architectural: one barrier has a gate and opposed hidden and exposed faces.

activation_trace.role: Showing a door while concealing an exit supplies the human pattern spatialized by the barrier.
A raised enclosure gives the split a material perimeter.
The entrance retained inside the barrier echoes the displayed access of the hypocrisy image.
Hidden inwardness locates mercy on the concealed face.
Emergence into view locates punishment on the exposed face.
Tender mercy names the protected interior outcome.
Painful punishment names the exterior outcome.

changed_reading.before: The wall is scenery separating two populations.
changed_reading.after: The wall spatially discloses the concealed-versus-displayed structure already carried by the name المنافقون.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context establishes a proper outward flow: expend entrusted goods and make a loan whose return is multiplied. At the deadline the hypocrites reverse that flow, requesting another person's light, when neither substitution nor withheld value can be tendered.

activation_trace.role: Good sought from another is the focus scene's attempted incoming transfer.
Outgoing expenditure supplies the earlier, approved direction of transfer.
Cutting out wealth or work for returned recompense supplies the context's credit model.
Increase by a like amount makes proper giving generative rather than depleting.
Substituting one thing for another is explicitly unavailable after separation.
Withholding supplies the blocked outward flow that contrasts with the final request.

structural_cues: 57:7 and 57:10 repeat expenditure; 57:11 promises multiplied return; 57:15 rejects ransom; 57:24 names withholding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, lending, multiplication, withholding, and a final request to take light; I infer that failed outward release helps explain unavailable inward credit. A live alternative is that light tracks faith without a specific charity causal chain.

changed_reading.before: The denied borrowing is an isolated emergency request.
changed_reading.after: The request culminates a reversed moral economy: those now seeking inward transfer failed the context's prior movement of value outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context turns light from a detachable luminous object into a trajectory and capacity: one is brought out into it, it moves purposefully ahead, and it is made for walking. The focus request therefore seeks path-capacity only after paths have separated.

activation_trace.role: Seeking another's light supplies the detachable-object model that context revises.
Passage to the outside supplies a completed darkness-to-light transition.
Illumination belongs to the travelers whose route the next branch animates.
Purposeful movement toward a goal makes their light route-forming and forward-directed.
Causing something to assume a state presents light as a granted capacity.
Walking names the sustained use for that light.
Mercy paired with made walking-light connects the later grant to the focus wall's interior.

structural_cues: 57:9 gives a darkness-to-light trajectory, 57:12 places moving light ahead, and 57:28 makes light something walked by while pairing it with mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transition, purposeful movement, made light, walking, and mercy; I infer a durable orientation or capacity rather than a portable substance. Visible luminosity remains a live simultaneous rendering.

changed_reading.before: The hypocrites lack an object that nearby believers might share.
changed_reading.after: They lack the already-formed capacity by which the believers' route unfolds, and proximity cannot create it after the path divides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to return behind gains a temporal edge from the unequal before and after of an opening, the self-damaging wait, and the later command to race. Spatial reversal becomes an impossible demand to recover the earlier time for action.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the focus command's literal reversal.
The side behind supplies the spatial direction that context temporalizes.
Precedence marks an earlier side of a consequential threshold.
A beginning that opens what follows supplies the threshold separating times of action.
After-versus-before confirms that formally similar later action is not temporally identical.
Waiting supplies the delay that lets the decisive command arrive first.
Advancing in a race supplies the context's opposite to delay and backward return.

structural_cues: 57:10 distinguishes action before the opening from action after it; 57:14 says they waited until the command came; 57:21 commands racing forward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spatial behind, consequential before and after, waiting, and racing; I infer that the reply exposes irrecoverable opportunity. The literal instruction to search in a rearward place remains live.

changed_reading.before: Go back is a spatial rebuff or taunt.
changed_reading.after: Go back also names the impossible recovery of an earlier actionable time squandered by waiting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated hidden/manifest pair and the post-scene inventory of self-testing, doubt, and deceptive glitter make the wall a disclosure device: an inward history becomes an outwardly fixed geography.

activation_trace.role: Displaying one access while concealing another supplies the latent split carried by the actors.
Hidden inwardness gives the barrier an unseen face.
Emergence into view gives the barrier a disclosed face.
The earlier hidden designation establishes inwardness as a surah-scale axis.
The paired manifest designation establishes disclosure as the corresponding axis.
Testing a person or metal supplies the first internal operation named after the wall appears.
Agitated doubt supplies instability within the prior shared appearance.
Deceptive glitter that does not endure supplies the attractive surface masking the inner trajectory.

structural_cues: 57:3 places the manifest and hidden together; 57:14 follows the barrier with a causal sequence addressed to the excluded group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated pair and a self-corrupting sequence; I infer that the exterior wall materializes a previously latent division. A live alternative is that the wall only assigns outcomes and does not image psychology.

changed_reading.before: The barrier imposes a new distinction from outside.
changed_reading.after: The barrier makes visible and durable a distinction that had been hidden within apparent companionship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the later scale-and-iron cluster onto the wall scene. It remains anchored in the focus's striking, separation, and enclosing wall, while the context branches supply just measure and a discriminating barrier. Render only as a material analogy for a verdict, not as a claim that the wall is iron or that 57:25 directly explains its composition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ makes separation an imposed, material event.

activation_trace.role: One thing brought against another supplies the imposed material act.
Separation supplies the result of that act.
A raised enclosure gives the distinction resistant form.
A scale of justice supplies the adjudicative analogy.
Justice and equity characterize the proposed sorting function.
A barrier and distinguishing limit links iron's root inventory to the wall's edge.

changed_reading.before: The wall is only a physical obstacle.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the struck wall is a verdict rendered as a resistant, discriminating boundary.

strongest_changes: The last-minute request reverses the context's economy of expenditure and good lending.
Light becomes prior path-capacity that runs ahead and is walked by, not merely a shareable object.
Return behind becomes temporal as well as spatial, exposing an opportunity lost through waiting.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's own hidden-exit image for ن ف ق folds into its gate and opposed wall faces, while context makes that inner split visible through giving, movement, and irreversible timing.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link between withholding and unavailable light is abductive rather than explicit.
The temporal force of وراءكم coexists with its literal spatial direction.
The scale-and-iron reading should remain a qualified material analogy.
